name: Green & Cream Glossy Stack Bangle Set ( Size 2.6-2.8)
description:
Size - 2.6 to 2.8 . 
Elevate your everyday style with this elegant Green & Cream Stack Bangle Set. Featuring two deep green glossy bangles paired with a beautiful cream-toned centre bangle, this three-piece set creates a sophisticated and stylish layered look.

The smooth, rounded design adds a modern touch while the rich green and neutral cream combination makes it easy to pair with a variety of outfits. Perfect for everyday wear, festive occasions, brunches, parties, and special gatherings.

name: Green Emerald Cut Drop Earrings
description:
Add a bold touch of elegance to your jewellery collection with these Green Emerald Cut Drop Earrings. Featuring stunning faceted green stones in a sleek rectangular cut, these earrings combine a rich jewel tone with a graceful two-tier drop design.

The polished golden setting beautifully complements the vibrant green stones, creating a sophisticated statement look. Perfect for parties, festive occasions, weddings, dinners, and special celebrations, these earrings effortlessly elevate both ethnic and western outfits.

name: Champagne Round Stud Earrings
description:
Elevate your look with our Champagne Round Stud Earrings, featuring a beautifully faceted champagne-coloured centre stone surrounded by a sparkling studded border. The classic round design and elegant golden finish add a refined touch to any outfit.

Perfect for parties, festive occasions, weddings, dinners, and everyday styling, these statement earrings effortlessly bring sophistication and sparkle to your jewellery collection.

name: Golden CZ Butterfly Earrings
description:
Make a graceful statement with our Golden CZ Butterfly Earrings, designed to add a delicate touch of sparkle to every look. Featuring an elegant butterfly silhouette adorned with shimmering CZ stones and a radiant golden finish, these earrings beautifully blend sophistication with a playful charm.

Perfect for festive occasions, parties, dinners, celebrations, or everyday styling, they pair effortlessly with both ethnic and western outfits. A timeless addition to your jewellery collection and a thoughtful gift for someone special.
